profiles.limits: Managed DOCX defaults, sizing, marks and notes; explicit layout and native boundaries remain.
Typed local properties, deterministic pictures, bounded nested IF and managed STYLEREF; unsupported fields retain caches with diagnostics.
Opt-in typed controls and explicit local XML binding; fixed output requires an explicit display view and ordinary managed profile.
Bounded mixed/master-detail repeats, prepared cross-tabs and caller fragments; ownership and resource gates remain.
Body/cell bold, italic, size and color; mirrored explicit complex-script companions and unchanged language/proofing metadata; unsupported histories reject.
Unique exact whole-paragraph moves and matching section topology; cross-section/ambiguous moves reject.
Plain header/footer text insert/delete; fields, structured owners and format history in revised stories reject.
Quarter turns and opt-in shrink-to-fit to a six-point minimum; ordinary managed paragraphs and fixed output only.
At most 64 fixed unrotated boxes in one section; complete-line flow; ambiguous implicit zero heads and terminal overflow reject.
Editable line, ellipse and default rounded rectangle; managed PDF/XPS/SVG vectors; unsupported effects and overlapping explicit layers reject.

limits: Named combinations only; no general rendering parity claim.
Historical reference failures and exact-release runtime evidence remain separate.
Actual net462 runtime, Android/macOS releases, extra OCR languages and cryptographic features remain unqualified or unsupported.
